title: Mechanical Eye Over Dystopia
description: A colossal green biomechanical eye dominates the right foreground, its intricate iris reflecting a dark city silhouette. To the left, a massive steampunk spider robot with glowing orange eyes and multiple mechanical limbs towers over a ruined cobblestone street lined with damaged buildings, smoke, and flickering lights.
prompt: Surreal cyberpunk scene featuring a gigantic intricate green biomechanical eye with detailed iris and pupil reflection of a dark city, positioned on the right. A massive rusty steampunk spider robot with glowing orange eyes and many mechanical limbs stands on the left over a broken cobblestone street. Decaying gothic buildings, smoke, fire, and hanging signs fill the dystopian background under a stormy sky.
